name: Notion Integration
description: Official Notion workspace integration powered by natural language and AI tool calling. Create structured Notion pages with native Markdown blocks, search notes, or inspect recent workspace updates.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.3.0: English predetermined UI strings with minimalist Chattree monochrome styling, native Notion Markdown blocks (headings, bullets, numbered lists, quotes, dividers), Unicode \uXXXX decoding, whitespace-tolerant JSON parsing, bounded search title extraction, auto-clear invalid parent_id, and shorter token-safe AI content guidelines.

tools.description: Official Notion integration. Output ONLY a single valid JSON object with no extra text. For action='create', provide a concise 'title' (max 80 chars, never copy the user prompt verbatim) and write a complete, well-structured 'content' (180-350 words) in the user's language using Markdown (# headings, - bullets, 1. lists, > quotes, --- dividers) separated by \n\n. Never leave 'content' empty for 'create'.

intentContract.description: Interpret the user's natural-language Notion request and return ONE valid JSON tool call only. For action='create', generate a clear 'title' and structured Markdown 'content' (180-350 words) in the same language as the user's request.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action to perform: 'create' (create a new page with full generated content), 'search' (search Notion pages), 'list' (list recent pages), 'status' (check connection status), 'config' (save secret_/ntn_ API token), 'parent' (set parent page ID or URL), 'disconnect' (remove saved token), or 'help' (show usage).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Concise, descriptive Notion page title (max 80 chars). Never copy the raw user prompt as the title.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Structured Markdown body for the Notion page (required when action='create', 180-350 words). Use #/##/### headings, - bullets, 1. numbered lists, > quotes, and --- dividers separated by \n\n.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Search query (when action='search'), integration token secret_/ntn_ (when action='config'), or parent page ID/URL (when action='parent').

examples.input: create a notion page with the top 5 mobile app ideas for 2027

output.title: Top 5 Mobile App Ideas for 2027
output.content:
